Old '''Snert''' is the [[innkeeper]] of [[The Grand Hike]] in [[Caemlyn]].

==Appearance==
Snert is an ugly man who is missing several teeth, an eye, and most the hair on his head. He also has a very hairy chest.

==Activities==
[[Matrim Cauthon]] and [[Birgitte Silverbow]] take a table in Old Snert's common room to talk about the [[Tower of Ghenjei]]. Birgitte opines that if Snert were a few years younger and if his nose were broken in a few places, she might be interested in him.{{ref/book|13|22}}
